description: Telling a client within 1 business day when an ILI anomaly appears to need immediate action; answering client calls about active digs and leak-detection alarms under review
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Client contracts ask for notice within 1 business day so the operator can decide on pressure reductions under its own program; a missed call could delay a safety decision. RPO 24 h because the source data is also held by the client and the ILI vendor
manual_workaround: Phone and text from the mobile phone; read the ILI feature list on the client portal from any clean device; dictate the finding to the client's integrity engineer and confirm in writing later
dependent_third_parties: Client A, B, and C integrity engineers; phone carrier
dependent_people_or_facilities: Engineer-owner (single point of failure; the only engineer)

description: ILI anomaly assessment and dig prioritization, integrity management program support, and leak-detection reviews; drafting, checking, and sealing reports
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Deliverable dates in work orders (usually 5 to 10 business days); about $750 of billable work per working day; Client A is half of revenue. RPO 24 h is met for files in cloud storage (version history) but not for local analysis files and scripts on the laptop, which are copied to USB about monthly
manual_workaround: Re-download client data from the client portal or file transfer site; rebuild analysis in the engineering software on a replacement laptop; ask the client for a short extension in writing
dependent_third_parties: Clients A, B, C; engineering software vendor (license server); productivity suite provider

business_process: Client data intake and secure exchange
description: Receiving ILI drives and portal data; exchanging files with subcontractors; returning or destroying client data at project end; handling Client A's SSI records
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Delays hold up BP-02; mishandling SSI or client data is a 49 CFR Part 1520 and contract issue, which is why regulatory impact is Severe even though downtime is tolerable
manual_workaround: Client sends a fresh copy through its portal or on a new vendor drive; subcontractor work pauses

description: Monthly invoices to clients; receiving payments; paying subcontractors; issuing 1099s
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Cash flow: about $15,000 invoiced a month; clients pay in 30 days; savings cover about two months of expenses. A fraudulent change of bank details is the larger risk than downtime
manual_workaround: Invoice from a word processor template and email; pay subcontractors by bank transfer from the bank's own site
dependent_third_parties: Accounting SaaS provider; bank; clients' accounts payable

description: Contracts, insurance, license renewal, tax records, security records, and these deliverables
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Deadlines are measured in weeks; security records must exist when Client A asks (questionnaire due 2026-10-30)
manual_workaround: Paper copies of the key contracts and the insurance policy in the home office
